## Guides
- [Your first step before buying a home (it isn't looking at houses)](https://nazarmn.com/blog/your-first-step-before-buying-a-home/): The first step to buying a home in Minnesota: get clear on your timeline, your monthly payment and your cash, then talk to a lender. A plain checklist from a local agent.
- [Buying a home in Minnesota, start to finish: what it actually looks like](https://nazarmn.com/blog/buying-your-first-home-in-minnesota/): A start-to-finish walkthrough of buying a home in Minnesota: pre-approval, showings, offers, inspection, appraisal and closing, with what you do and what your agent does at each stage.
- [Which investment properties make sense, and which ones don't](https://nazarmn.com/blog/which-investment-properties-make-sense/): How to tell a good rental or small apartment building from a bad one: real expenses, cash flow, cap rate and debt coverage, with a worked fourplex example.
- [Selling your home: what the 30 days before you list look like](https://nazarmn.com/blog/selling-your-home-what-the-first-30-days-look-like/): What happens in the month before your Minnesota home hits the market: pricing, the prep list that pays, photos, and launch day, from a local listing agent.
- [What I look for first in a home inspection report](https://nazarmn.com/blog/what-i-look-for-in-an-inspection-report/): An engineer turned real estate agent on how to read a home inspection report: what matters, what is normal, and what to ask the seller to fix.
- [Contract for deed in Minnesota: how it works and when it makes sense](https://nazarmn.com/blog/contract-for-deed-minnesota/): A plain-English guide to contract for deed in Minnesota for buyers and sellers: how payments work, the risks on each side, and when seller financing fits.
- [How off-market commercial deals actually happen](https://nazarmn.com/blog/how-off-market-commercial-deals-happen/): How off-market apartment and commercial property deals come together in Minnesota: finding owners, earning the conversation, and structuring terms.
- [Selling in spring? Take the listing photos in fall](https://nazarmn.com/blog/selling-in-spring-take-photos-in-fall/): Why Minnesota sellers planning a spring listing should shoot exterior photos in September or October, plus a short fall prep list.
